signIn.title: Sign in to CampusPulse
signIn.subtitle: New here? Signing in creates your account.

problems.identity-in-use: That UPT account already belongs to another CampusPulse account. To use it, sign out and continue with UPT.
problems.already-linked: This account is already linked to a different UPT account. Unlink that one first.

problems.microsoft-timeout: The Microsoft sign-in took too long. Try again.

upt.label: UPT account

upt.lastMethod: UPT is your only way to sign in, so it can't be unlinked.

upt.unlinkBody: You'll sign in with {{email}} from now on. Your deadlines and settings stay.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.body: Deletes your account and everything in it, on every device: your sign-in methods, deadlines, settings and reminders. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Everything in it is deleted for good, and every device is signed out.
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete your account. Try again.

home.overline: For UPT students, made by students
home.tagline: Your UPT campus, in one app.
home.pitch: CampusPulse puts your timetable, exams, the campus map and Campus Virtual in one place. The Android app is coming; the web app works now.
home.notice: A student project. Not an official UPT app.

preview.title: Built for your daily student life at UPT
preview.subtitle: See how your classes, room locations, and deadlines look in one unified, distraction-free view.

map.description: Find B528A or 303CP without asking around.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: This page will describe what data CampusPulse collects, why, where it is stored, how long it is kept, and how to contact us. Google Play requires it before the app can be published.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.intro: You can delete your CampusPulse account at any time, here or in the app. It can't be undone.
accountDeletion.done: Your account and everything in it were deleted, and you're signed out.

what.account: Your account: its email and name
what.sessions: Every session, so every device is signed out
what.settings: Your study group, subjects and class reminder settings
what.devices: The phones registered for class reminders

accountDeletion.campusVirtual: Your Campus Virtual connection is never sent to CampusPulse: it lives only on your phone, and goes when you disconnect it or remove the app.
accountDeletion.kept: Only a count of how many accounts were deleted each day, with nothing that identifies you. Deleted data stays only in our system-wide backups, is never used for anything, and is gone from them after at most about a year.
accountDeletion.signInFirst: Sign in to delete your account here.
accountDeletion.contact: Can't sign in? Write to <mail>{{email}}</mail> from the address on your account, and we'll delete it for you.
